title: Protest intensifies against large-scale water extraction from Tejaswini river in Keralam’s Kasaragod
description: The proposed Trikkaripur adjoining panchayat drinking water project of the Kerala Water Authority envisages drawing water from the Tejaswini and supplying it to Kariverllur-Peralam and Kankol-Alapadamba panchayats in Kannur and five panchayats in Kasaragod
